next_recommendation: BREAKTHROUGH: hybrid_best (epoch 3) is the SECOND representation (after center_projected) to pass BOTH adversarial gates WITH meaningful fractal structure (LangDom=0.711, JuristPref=0.599, 4→57 clusters). critical_findings.center_projected_validated: ONLY representation passing BOTH adversarial language dominance (0.763 < 0.85) AND jurist pairwise preference (0.528 > 0.5) WITH meaningful hierarchical structure (improvement_rate=59%, hierarchical_advantage=0.027, 7→105 clusters). Consistent across 3 independent runs.
critical_findings.signal_ablation_hybrids_fail_adversarial: All promising v4/v5 hybrids FAIL adversarial gates: legal_area_tfidf (LangDom=0.914, JP=0.131), legal_issues_outcomes (1.000, 0.000), hybrid_erwaegungen_03 (0.875, 0.248), hybrid_sachverhalt_07 (0.936, 0.121). Hybrids α=0.3 pass LangDom but fail JP; α≥0.5 fail both. Fractal harness promise ≠ adversarial robustness.
critical_findings.signal_outcome_tfidf_overcluster: Passes adversarial (LangDom=0.446, JP=0.849) but SEVERE OVERCLUSTERING: 1 coarse → 1000 fine clusters. Same pathology as pure citation roles. Adversarial PASS is false positive artifact.
critical_findings.hybrids_alpha03_fractal_ok_but_jurist_fa: hybrid_cited_decisions_0.3 (8→136, 56% imp), hybrid_norm_refs_0.3 (9→162, 45% imp), hybrid_legal_area_0.3 (7→110, 64% imp, NMI=0.679) have good fractal structure but JuristPref 0.32-0.46 < 0.5 threshold.
critical_findings.legal_embeddings_pretrained_fail: xlm_roberta_base, paraphrase_multilingual_minilm, multilingual_e5_small all FAIL adversarial (LangDom≈1.0, JP≈0.0). Fine-tuning multilingual-e5-small BLOCKED by GPU.
critical_findings.contrastive_projection_overcluster: CPU contrastive projection head (384→256→128) on frozen multilingual-e5-small PASSES adversarial (LangDom=0.459, JP=0.850) but OVERCLUSTERS (1→1000 fine) — same artifact as signal_outcome_tfidf and pretrained model. Pure contrastive loss destroys global hierarchy. Multi-objective loss preserving center_projected structure needed.
critical_findings.citation_role_pipeline_fixed_but_sparse: 25,458 role annotations extracted, 1,124 ID mappings, 465 resolved court citations (4.5%). Pure roles overcluster (1→1000). Hybrids marginal gains. Corpus scale to 192k needed for signal density.
critical_findings.jurist_eval_framework_ready: 200 evaluation questions generated with UI spec, sampling strategy, and analysis plan; ready for human study recruitment. Human evaluation NOT EXECUTED (needs 5-10 Swiss jurists).
critical_findings.adversarial_vs_fractal_gap: Fractal harness (cluster-level taxonomic alignment) and adversarial benchmarks (neighbor-level multilingual invariance + legal relevance) measure DIFFERENT properties. Legal signals excel at former, fail at latter. This gap explains why v4/v5 'promising' hybrids fail v6 adversarial validation.
critical_findings.hybrid_objective_breakthrough: Hybrid objective (λ_contrastive=2.0, λ_preserve=0.5, λ_hierarchy=0.5) on center_projected produces valid adversarial pass at epoch 3: LangDom=0.711 (<0.85), JuristPref=0.599 (>0.5), 4 coarse → 57 fine clusters, NO overclustering. Trade-offs vs center_projected: Better LangDom, JP, coarse/fine purity; Worse: fewer coarse clusters (4 vs 7), lower improvement rate (42% vs 74%), lower legal_area NMI (0.557 vs 0.587), lower hierarchical advantage. DEGRADES by epoch 6 (JP→0.45) — contrastive loss overfits branch/language pairs without finer legal structure constraints.

verdict: center_projected remains DEFAULT reference.
